cohort: 142 newborns with IUGR (birth weight and birth length below the 10th percentile for gestational age) and 142 matched controls
finding: Newborns with IUGR had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery and were more likely to experience hypoglycemia and intraventricular hemorrhage compared to controls.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more frequent in the IUGR group (66.9%) compared with controls (46.5%; p=0.0006).
birth_weight: Below the 10th percentile for gestational age
